description:
FILED s474b (Fable, 2026-09-07) -- USER: "Sounds good" to widening AFTER the board has a cause per row (#1502), so blockedBy #1502.

WHY THESE: measured 2026-09-07 -- every one is under ~/.cpan/build with ZERO .xs files, and each exercises a language area the 14-dist board does not: Moo (the OO framework PCL targets, docs/moo-status.md, memory project_moo_progress -- 71 t-files; Sub-Quote 15 and Role-Tiny come with it), Getopt-Long (core-adjacent, used by every script), Path-Tiny (file I/O, overload, stringification), Test-Deep (deep structures, overload, closures), Pod-Simple (a large regex-heavy state-machine parser), Math-BigInt (numeric edge cases -- memory project_math_bigint_shim: PCL has a shim; decide shim-vs-real per the layer rule), Memoize (closures, symbol table), HTTP-Tiny + HTTP-Message (headers, sockets -- network legs skip cleanly under perl too).  App-cpanminus (1 t-file) is NOT a suite target: it is a REAL PROGRAM -- `cpanm --version`, `cpanm --help`, `cpanm --info <local tarball>` / `--look` run under PCL vs perl, no network -- the first "does a real tool run" row on STATUS.md.

RULES per round: the board command in docs/STATUS.md (append the dists; `--no-dist-lib` only where a dist's lib would shadow an installed XS module); real perl beside it (oracle rule 1); the snapshot header names every perl-side skip; new FAIL/PARTIAL files get the #1502 treatment (cause per cluster via the row-level file; <= 1 h fixes ship; the rest filed with reproducers) BEFORE the next round's dists are added, so the queue is families, not counts.  A module PCL SHIPS a shim for (lib/<Module>.pm, docs/shipped-modules.md) is scored against the shim AND noted -- a dist's own test suite is the shim's parity check (#238's shape).

BARS per round: snapshot blessed with causes; STATUS.md board row updated (dist count, file count, verdict counts); the drop census re-run (the new dists' t-files join the cpan population of baselines/parse-error-drop-census-s399.tsv, rows blessed with causes); gate green; DECIDED section per round with the family table.
subject: WIDEN the CPAN board with pure-Perl dists ALREADY ON DISK, in rounds of 2-3 so each round's new families are filed before the next: Moo (71 t) + Getopt-Long (8) first; then Path-Tiny (30), Test-Deep (42); then Pod-Simple (74), Math-BigInt (54), Memoize (16), HTTP-Tiny (32) + HTTP-Message (23); and App-cpanminus as an END-TO-END PROGRAM target
